remarks: **FULLY FURNISHED** Welcome to 5544 Sugartown Rd, your fully updated and turn-key retreat in the heart of Great Valley. Currently used as a successful short term rental, this fully updated 4-bedroom, 3 full bath home has been thoughtfully renovated throughout, combining comfort, style, and functionality-easily accommodating an astonishing 16 guests. Recent improvements just this past year include a new well tank, new water softener system, new hot water tank, and a 4-stage filtration system for well water-providing peace of mind for years to come. The home also features newly renovated bathrooms and a brand-new hot tub, creating the ideal space to relax after a day outdoors or to boost income potential for short term stays. Extensive upgrades and improvements have been made throughout this home over the years, too many to fully capture in one description. With all of the hand-crafted furnishings and necessities included, this property is truly move-in ready or primed for immediate short-term rental use. Located just minutes from Ellicottville’s ski country, Holiday Valley, and year-round attractions including shopping and dining, it’s perfectly positioned for both personal enjoyment and income potential. Whether you’re looking for a weekend getaway or a cash-cow investment property, this is the perfect option. VR Pricing, Seller will entertain offers from $479,900-$529,900
